Game Overview

Lemonade War puts players into a two-player experience centered on race against time in Lemonade War, a thrilling pixelated platformer. Strategically gather lemons while dodging rising floodwaters. Balance speed and caution as you dash between the tree and your stand. Will you master the art of efficient collecting, or will you let your load slip away?

Playing Lemonade War comes down to a simple loop. Race against time in Lemonade War, a thrilling pixelated platformer. Strategically gather lemons while dodging rising floodwaters.
